parameters.query:
UPDATE leads SET
  venue_name   = COALESCE(NULLIF($2, ''), venue_name),
  venue_type   = COALESCE(NULLIF($3, ''), venue_type),
  contact_name = COALESCE(NULLIF($4, ''), contact_name),
  email        = COALESCE(NULLIF($5, ''), email),
  phone        = COALESCE(NULLIF($6, ''), phone),
  website_url  = COALESCE(NULLIF($7, ''), website_url),
  notes        = COALESCE($8, notes)
WHERE id = $1::uuid
RETURNING *;
